verses.en: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Agora verás o que hei de fazer a Faraó; pois por uma poderosa mão os deixará ir, sim, por uma poderosa mão os lançará de sua terra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Now you will see what I am about to do to Pharaoh; for by a strong hand he will be forced to let them go, driving them out of his land because of my outstretched arm.

verses.en: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD:
verses.pt: Falou mais Deus a Moisés, e disse-lhe: Eu sou Jeová.
verses.en_web: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am Yahweh;
verses.en_bbe: And God said to Moses, I am Yahweh:

verses.en: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
verses.pt: Apareci a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó, como o Deus Todo-Poderoso; mas pelo meu nome Jeová, não lhes fui conhecido.
verses.en_web: and I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.
verses.en_bbe: I let myself be seen by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, as God, the Ruler of all; but they had no knowledge of my name Yahweh.

verses.en: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
verses.pt: Estabeleci o meu pacto com eles para lhes dar a terra de Canaã, a terra de suas peregrinações, na qual foram peregrinos.
verses.en_web: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.
verses.en_bbe: And I made an agreement with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their wanderings.

verses.en: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.pt: Ademais, tenho ouvido o gemer dos filhos de Israel, aos quais os egípcios vêm escravizando; e lembrei-me do meu pacto.
verses.en_web: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.en_bbe: And truly my ears are open to the cry of the children of Israel whom the Egyptians keep under their yoke; and I have kept in mind my agreement.

verses.en: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
verses.pt: Portanto dize aos filhos de Israel: Eu sou Jeová; eu vos tirarei de debaixo das cargas dos egípcios, livrar-vos-ei da sua servidão, e vos resgatarei com braço estendido e com grandes juízos.
verses.en_web: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments:
verses.en_bbe: Say then to the children of Israel, I am Yahweh, and I will take you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians, and make you safe from their power, and will make you free by the strength of my arm after great punishments.

verses.en: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.pt: Eu vos tomarei por meu povo e serei vosso Deus; e vós sabereis que eu sou Jeová vosso Deus, que vos tiro de debaixo das cargas dos egípcios.
verses.en_web: and I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.en_bbe: And I will take you to be my people and I will be your God; and you will be certain that I am the Lord your God, who takes you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.

verses.en: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Eu vos introduzirei na terra que jurei dar a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó; e vo-la darei por herança. Eu sou Jeová.
verses.en_web: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am Yahweh.’”
verses.en_bbe: And I will be your guide into the land which I made an oath to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for your heritage: I am Yahweh.

verses.en: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
verses.pt: Assim falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel, mas eles não lhe deram ouvidos, por causa da angústia de espírito e da dura servidão.
verses.en_web: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said these words to the children of Israel, but they gave no attention to him, because of the grief of their spirit and the cruel weight of their work.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.pt: Vai, fala a Faraó, rei do Egito, que deixe sair os filhos de Israel da sua terra.
verses.en_web: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”
verses.en_bbe: Go in and say to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, that he is to let the children of Israel go out of his land.

verses.en: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
verses.pt: Moisés, porém, respondeu perante o Senhor, dizendo: Eis que os filhos de Israel não me têm ouvido: como, pois, me ouvirá Faraó a mim, que sou incircunciso de lábios?
verses.en_web: Moses spoke before Yahweh, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, who am of uncircumcised lips?”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses, answering the Lord, said, See, the children of Israel will not give ear to me; how then will Pharaoh give ear to me, whose lips are unclean?

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Todavia o Senhor falou a Moisés e a Arão, e deu-lhes mandamento para os filhos de Israel, e para Faraó, rei do Egito, a fim de tirarem os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito..
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to Moses and Aaron, with orders for the children of Israel and for Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to take the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

verses.en: These be the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.
verses.pt: Estes são os cabeças das casas de seus pais: Os filhos de Rúben o primogênito de Israel: Hanoque e Palu, Hezrom e Carmi; estas são as famílias de Rúben.
verses.en_web: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
verses.en_bbe: These are the heads of their fathers' families: the sons of Reuben the oldest son of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi: these are the families of Reuben.

verses.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Simeão: Jemuel, Jamim, Oade, Jaquim, Zoar e Saul, filho de uma cananéia; estas são as famílias de Simeão.
verses.en_web: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and Jachin and Zohar and Shaul, the son of a woman of Canaan: these are the families of Simeon.

verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.
verses.pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Levi, segundo as suas gerações: Gérson, Coate e Merári; e os anos da vida de Levi foram cento e trinta e sete anos.
verses.en_web: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the names of the sons of Levi in the order of their generations: Gershon and Kohath and Merari: and the years of Levi's life were a hundred and thirty-seven.

verses.en: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Gérson: Líbni e Simei, segundo as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, in the order of their families.

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom e Uziel; e os anos da vida de Coate foram cento e trinta e três anos.
verses.en_web: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel: and the years of Kohath's life were a hundred and thirty-three.

verses.en: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Merári: Mali e Musi; estas são as famílias de Levi, segundo as suas gerações.
verses.en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi: these are the families of the Levites, in the order of their generations.

verses.en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
verses.pt: Ora, Anrão tomou por mulher a Joquebede, sua tia; e ela lhe deu Arão e Moisés; e os anos da vida de Anrão foram cento e trinta e sete anos.
verses.en_web: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were a hundred and thirty-seven years.
verses.en_bbe: And Amram took Jochebed, his father's sister, as wife; and she gave birth to Aaron and Moses: and the years of Amram's life were a hundred and thirty-seven.

verses.en: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Izar: Corá, Nofegue e Zicri.
verses.en_web: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Izhar: Korah and Nepheg and Zichri.

verses.en: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Uziel: Misael, Elzafã e Sitri.
verses.en_web: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Sithri.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael and Elzaphan and Sithri.

verses.en: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.pt: Arão tomou por mulher a Eliseba, filha de Aminadabe, irmã de Nasom; e ela lhe deu Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
verses.en_web: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.en_bbe: And Aaron took as his wife Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon; and she gave birth to Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.en: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Corá: Assir, Elcana e Abiasafe; estas são as famílias dos coraítas.
verses.en_web: The sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Korah: Assir and Elkanah and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korahites.

verses.en: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
verses.pt: Eleazar, filho de Arão, tomou por mulher uma das filhas de Putiel; e ela lhe deu Finéias; estes são os chefes das casa, paternas dos levitas, segundo as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: And Eleazar, Aaron's son, took as his wife one of the daughters of Putiel; and she gave birth to Phinehas. These are the heads of the families of the Levites, in the order of their families.

verses.en: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
verses.pt: Estes são Arão e Moisés, aos quais o Senhor disse: Tirai os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, segundo os seus exércitos.
verses.en_web: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom Yahweh said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”
verses.en_bbe: These are the same Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said, Take the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt in their armies.

verses.en: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
verses.pt: Foram eles os que falaram a Faraó, rei do Egito, a fim de tirarem do Egito os filhos de Israel; este Moisés e este Arão.
verses.en_web: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.
verses.en_bbe: These are the men who gave orders to Pharaoh to let the children of Israel go out of Egypt: these are the same Moses and Aaron.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.pt: No dia em que o Senhor falou a Moisés na terra do Egito,
verses.en_web: On the day when Yahweh spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.en_bbe: And on the day when the word of the Lord came to Moses in the land of Egypt,

verses.en: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
verses.pt: disse o Senhor a Moisés: Eu sou Jeová; dize a Faraó, rei do Egito, tudo quanto eu te digo.
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying, “I am Yahweh. Speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I speak to you.”
verses.en_bbe: The Lord said to Moses, I am the Lord: say to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, everything I am saying to you.

verses.en: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
verses.pt: Respondeu Moisés perante o Senhor: Eis que eu sou incircunciso de lábios; como, pois, me ouvirá Faraó;
verses.en_web: Moses said before Yahweh, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to the Lord, My lips are unclean; how is it possible that Pharaoh will give me a hearing?
